scenes.texte: Pre-load started on November 10. The game launches this Thursday, November 19.
Before Thursday, check your free space, turn on automatic downloads, and keep your console on or in rest mode. That's what Rockstar's FAQ asks for.
How much space is left on your console? Tell me in the comments, and follow for verified GTA 6 news.
